$comment: Story 4.1 F5 (ADR-148): the run ends at the main road; the long walk east in the dark; it lands at the foot of the hill at 21:30 (4.2, ADR-150).

panels.title: OLD AIRPORT ROAD · 17:10
panels.text: You run until you can't, then you walk. Behind you the plates have stopped. Every door is shut.

panels.title: MARATHAHALLI BRIDGE · 20:05
panels.text: A single bike passes without lights. Neither of you looks at the other.

panels.title: AMBEDKAR NAGAR · 21:30
panels.text: At the top of the hill, one light. Purple.
